title: Sunflow battery module profile
description: Battery modules of an integration that shows each module as a Home Assistant device below the battery, and the entities of their values. Files under profiles/battery_modules/.

name.description: Name of the module type in the UI.

sub_device.description: Modules are sub-devices (of the inverter or a tower controller below it).

exclude_identifier.description: Devices with this text in an identifier are no module.

name_strip.description: Prefix removed from the device name.

required.description: Values a device must have to count as module.

value.description: End of the entity's unique_id, matched like role keys ('_' or '-' before it, wildcards allowed). Several matches: the shortest unique_id; with aggregate the max, min or mean of all.

ok.description: Status values (alarm, protection, fault): states meaning no problem; any other state is shown as problem. Without it 0 means no problem.
